summary: Shoshone County, Idaho lookout cab on the St. Joe National Forest, built 1935, abandoned 1953, now gone; no source describes the site today.

notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three. Two site pages, a county list and the FFLA list all agree on 1935 and 1953 and on the L-4 cab. No staffing, fire or present-day site evidence was found, so the story is short on purpose. The brief's county (Shoshone) is confirmed by the FFLA list. No Idaho register (NHLR or FFLOS) entry for this site was in the cache.
